description: Assemble a token-budgeted <memory_context> XML/Markdown block from a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { context, memories_used }. Ranks up to 500 namespace memories deterministically and packs lines greedily up to max(256, token_budget * 4) characters under "## Established Facts" (core/semantic) and "## Recent Context" (episodic/buffer). Use at session start or before planning a task to ground the model in one call; use recall_memories instead when you need raw memory objects and IDs.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to ground context around (never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Active task, feature, or session topic used to rank relevant facts and history.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget (~4 characters per token, default 4096) before truncating lower-ranked items.

name: build_context

memories_used.description: Number of memories packed within token_budget.

title: Build Session Context
